subject: Azure private offer — quoting workflow & channel split for Acme PO
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace@azure.com>; procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure private offer — quoting workflow & channel split for Acme PO

Hi all,

Following up on our conversation this morning — Acme is ready to move forward with a 12-month private offer for Redwood Dedicated capacity (estimated commit: $480k). Before we issue a formal private-offer quote, Azure needs:

- Confirmation of the acceptable channel margin split for the marketplace listing (Acme has an existing reseller who expects ~15% passback).
- The quoting workflow: can Azure generate a pre-signed PO and a private-offer link we can send to Acme procurement, or does Redwood need to submit the term sheet first?
- Any required partner paperwork (MSA or marketplace onboarding docs) that must be attached to the PO.

I attached a draft term sheet and the Acme SOW we discussed. Can the marketplace team confirm the sequence and any metadata fields we must populate (reseller id, partner margin field, partner type)? Acme would like the offer in their portal by EOD Friday PST.

Next steps I propose: Azure confirms the workflow and channel field names -> Redwood prepares final term sheet with partner margin populated -> Azure issues private-offer link -> Acme signs.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood-Azure-PO-term-sheet-v2.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)
Attachment: Acme-SOW-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 85KB)

From: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace@azure.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — quoting workflow & channel split for Acme PO

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the doc — happy to help. Workflow summary from Marketplace side:

1) Redwood submits a private-offer request via our partner portal (we can accept a prefilled CSV or the term sheet as a PDF).
2) Required metadata: publisher_id (Redwood), reseller_id (if passback to a reseller), partner_margin_percent (numeric), offer_commit_term_months, sku_list with unit price.
3) Azure will generate the private-offer link once the request is approved; the link can be sent directly to Acme procurement.
4) If Acme requires a pre-signed PO in the portal, we can attach the marketplace-generated PO as a supporting document — but Acme must accept marketplace terms or attach their procurement approval.

Partner paperwork: we need the signed Partner MSA on file for any reseller passback. If Redwood will be listing as the publisher and a third-party reseller is receiving a passback, include the reseller's partner GUID.

Notes on margins: Azure enforces that partner_margin_percent is advisory for internal splits; any external passback to a reseller should be documented in the MSA or a reseller agreement. For your scenario (~15% passback to Acme's reseller), include a partner_margin_percent = 15 and upload the reseller agreement as supplementary evidence.

We can fast-track approval for "private offers with reseller passback" if you provide: reseller GUID, reseller contact, MSA, and a brief justification for the passback.

DocuSign: we can attach a DocuSign packet if you need signatures on the term sheet, but the marketplace link is the canonical acceptance path.

I'll start a request and add Ben/Vanessa as contacts — expect a ticket (AZ-MKT-1129) and a private-offer link to draft by Thu morning PST.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Intake
Marketplace Partner Operations
Attachment: marketplace-guidelines-2026.pdf (reference)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Azure private offer — quoting workflow & channel split for Acme PO

Thanks for the update — good to see Azure can do the passback workflow. A couple of practical points from pricing/ops:

- We should not hardcode the 15% in the customer-facing term sheet; instead include a field in the private-offer metadata: partner_margin_percent = 15 so Azure can populate the marketplace accounting.
- For bookkeeping, Redwood will record the true net ARR and the reseller passback as an expense line. Finance needs the reseller GUID and the executed reseller agreement before we recognize revenue.
- Suggest we propose two quoting scenarios to Acme: (A) Marketplace canonical flow (fast, Azure-managed) with 15% passback noted in metadata (recommended) and (B) Traditional vendor-issued quote (Redwood invoice, reseller credited via rebate post-billing) — include clear timelines for invoicing and credits in each option.

I attached a short ops playbook snippet that outlines the preferred field names and the partner_guid format used in our ERP. If Azure can confirm the exact partner_guid field name and the expected file format for supplementary docs (PDF preferred), we can finalize the submission.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: marketplace-passback-playbook-snippet.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB)

Subject: Re: Azure private offer — quoting workflow & channel split for Acme PO

James / Acme procurement — looping you in with the Azure marketplace contact and our ops lead (Ben) to move this to completion. Per Azure: the cleanest path is the Marketplace private-offer link with partner_margin_percent = 15 and reseller GUID attached.

Action items:
- Acme: confirm you accept the marketplace private-offer link as the canonical acceptance mechanism (or request Redwood invoice route). If yes, please provide the reseller GUID (or authorize us to include the reseller contact already on file).
- Azure: please create ticket AZ-MKT-1129 + draft private-offer link and indicate any mandatory fields we must provide in the payload (exact field names).
- Redwood (Ben/Karthik): once Azure confirms the field names, we'll submit the private-offer request with the attachments (term sheet, reseller agreement).

James — we aim to have the draft link to you by Thu morning PST to meet your Friday deadline. If there are procurement constraints on accepting marketplace links, flag them immediately.

Thanks all,
Mina
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
